channel.description: We are the Warrior Monks of Christian Rock—slamming the jams that worship the Lamb, servants of the Almighty God. A Christian Rock and Metal Podcast.

channel.itunes:summary: Midnight Metal Monastery is where faith meets fury. A sanctuary for listeners seeking spiritual depth and heavy riffs. We lift high the name of Jesus Christ through powerful music and Scripture. We are the Warrior Monks of Christian Rock, slamming the jams that worship the Lamb and serving the Almighty God. Slay the Beast and live!
